content_sections.heading: About VNMKV
content_sections.text: Vasantrao Naik Marathwada Krishi Vidyapeeth is a university in Parbhani, and its Sorghum Research Station is issuing this notice. The posts fall under the central sector scheme "National Mission on High Yielding Seeds (NMHYS)". The work on sweet sorghum aims at the development of high yielding sweet sorghum hybrids and parental lines with high biomass, high sugar and high juice yield.

content_sections.heading: VNMKV Senior Research Fellow and Field Assistant Vacancy Details 2026

rows.consolidated_pay_per_month: Rs. 37,000 + HRA for 1st and 2nd year; Rs. 42,000 + HRA for 3rd year

content_sections.heading: VNMKV Senior Research Fellow and Field Assistant Eligibility 2026
content_sections.text: Age limit: Minimum 21 years and maximum 45 years. The application form asks for age on the date of interview. M.Sc.(Agri.) final year students who have submitted their thesis will be considered for the interview. If selected, they have to produce their Provisional Degree Certificate while joining. Only candidates having the essential qualifications will be entertained for the interview. Age relaxation for SC, ST, OBC, Physically Challenged, Ex-Serviceman and Women candidates is as per Govt. Rules. See the official notification for the full eligibility conditions of each post.

rows.mandatory_qualification: Master's / Ph.D. degree in Agril. Botany (Genetics and Plant Breeding)
Bachelor degree or diploma in Agriculture

content_sections.heading: Important Dates
content_sections.text: The main text of the notice gives the interview date as 13 November 2026. Clause 19 of its terms prints the reporting date as 13/10/2026, which falls before the notice's own date of 29 October 2026.

content_sections.heading: Selection Process
content_sections.text: If more applications are received, they will be shortlisted on merit, based on academic performances and experience. Only 1:5 proportionate shortlisted candidates will be interviewed by the Selection Committee. Reporting: 10:30 a.m. at the Directorate of Research, VNMKV, Parbhani. Late arrival after 11:00 AM will be considered as absent. No call letters will be issued, and no TA/DA or other expenses will be paid for attending.

content_sections.heading: Service Conditions
content_sections.text: The posts are purely temporary and contractual, initially up to 31 March 2027. They may be extended based on performance or till the termination of the project, whichever is earlier. The project period is printed as starting in 2026-27, with its end year printed as "20230-31". Place of work is the Sorghum Research Station, Parbhani. The selected candidate joins under the Officer Incharge & Sorghum Breeder and Principal Investigator, NMHYS. The positions are non-regular, time bound and co-terminus with the project, so selected candidates cannot claim a regular appointment. The candidate must give an undertaking not to leave the assignment half way and to complete the seed target in the prescribed time limit. Leaving the post requires one-month prior notice, failing which one month's amount must be remitted in lieu of notice. The selected candidate has to execute a bond on stamp paper as per university rule. The Director of Research may terminate the contract before the project ends, and no appeal will be entertained.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for VNMKV Senior Research Fellow and Field Assistant Recruitment 2026
content_sections.text: Take the application format from Annexure-I and Annexure-II of the official notification (PDF) . Fill a separate form for each post, because a format that deviates from the prescribed one will not be considered. Enclose your CV, a recent photograph and self-attested copies of the documents listed below. Send the hard copies personally or by post to: Officer Incharge & Principal Investigator, Sorghum Research Station, Parbhani 431 401. They should reach the office by the last date and time. If a near or distant relative is an employee of ICAR/IARI, declare the relative's name, designation, nature of duties and relationship in writing before the interview date, using Annexure-II. Other candidates furnish Annexure-II at the interview. Attend the interview at the venue with the documents listed below. Documents to enclose with the application: Copy certificates from matriculation onwards Date of birth certificate NET/equivalent certificates and mark-sheets Proof of experience and publications No objection certificate from the employer, for candidates who are employed Documents to bring to the interview: Hard copy of the duly filled application in the prescribed format One set of self-attested photocopies of certificates Original certificates for verification Two copies of a recent passport size photo Concealing facts or canvassing in any form shall lead to disqualification or termination. The Director of Research reserves the right to cancel or postpone the interview, or cancel specific posts, without assigning any reason. Any dispute falls under the jurisdiction of Parbhani Court only.

faq.question: Q1. Do I need to send an application before the walk-in interview?
faq.answer: Yes. The filled form in the Annexure-I and II format, with your CV and self-attested documents, should reach the Sorghum Research Station office, personally or by post, before the deadline.

faq.question: Q2. Can I apply for both posts?
faq.answer: The notice requires a separate application form for each post, in the prescribed proforma only.

faq.question: Q3. Can a final year M.Sc.(Agri.) student appear?
faq.answer: Yes, if the thesis has been submitted. A selected candidate must produce the Provisional Degree Certificate while joining.

faq.question: Q4. Will everyone who applies be interviewed?
faq.answer: Not necessarily. If more applications are received, only 1:5 proportionate shortlisted candidates, chosen on academic performances and experience, will be interviewed.

faq.question: Q5. Will I get a call letter?
faq.answer: No call letters will be issued. Applicants are expected to be present at the Directorate of Research, VNMKV, Parbhani, on the said date and time.

faq.question: Q6. What happens if I arrive after 11:00 AM?
faq.answer: Late arrival after 11:00 AM will be considered as absent, and reporting time is 10:30 a.m.

faq.question: Q7. How long will the contract last?
faq.answer: It runs initially up to 31 March 2027 and may be extended on performance or till the project ends, whichever is earlier.

faq.question: Q8. Does a working candidate need an NOC?
faq.answer: Yes. A candidate who has an employment needs a no objection certificate from the employer, and the application form asks for those details.
